item.title: New Research Blows Up the Myths Driving Vaping Bans
item.description: Vaping bans are often built on claims that sound settled but weaken under closer scrutiny. New research challenges the assumptions used to justify prohibition, especially around youth use, switching and the role of flavours for adults who smoke. Evidence should be allowed to disturb comfortable policy narratives. Public health cannot reduce harm by defending myths that make lower-risk alternatives harder to access. (Published on August 14, 2026bythewellnews.com)
